capabilities: Add and edit furigana readings on selected text
Remove Ruby markup while keeping the original text
Batch annotate multiple text and reading pairs
Toggle reading visibility and adjust reading size and position
extras: Manual installation only; not yet in the official community plugin list. Not fully tested on Android, iOS or in real Obsidian environments. No telemetry or external requests; readings must be entered by hand.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to attach Japanese readings to text, so furigana has to be written as raw HTML Ruby markup by hand.

relations.evidence: Existing Ruby annotations created with Templater are supported without migration.

summary: Plugin for manually adding, editing and removing Japanese furigana readings as HTML Ruby markup in notes.
